title: Block Traits
description: Change the connection, multiblock state, placement position and/or direction behaviors of a block

minecraft:connection.title: Minecraft Connection
minecraft:connection.description:
Adds connection states to the block. The values of these states are updated when the block or neighboring blocks change.

Properties:
• enabled_states (string[])

defaultSnippets.label: Block Connection
defaultSnippets.description: Adds connection states to the block. The values of these states are updated when the block or neighboring blocks change.

minecraft:multi_block.title: Minecraft Multi Block
minecraft:multi_block.description:
Adds the "minecraft:multi_block_part" state and multi block functionality to the block.

Properties:
• direction (string)
• enabled_states (string[])
• parts (int) = 2

defaultSnippets.label: Block Multi Block
defaultSnippets.description: Adds the "minecraft:multi_block_part" state and multi block functionality to the block.

minecraft:placement_direction.title: Minecraft Placement Direction
minecraft:placement_direction.description:
Adds the "minecraft:cardinal_direction", "minecraft:facing_direction" and/or "minecraft:corner_and_cardinal_direction" states and setter function to the block.

Properties:
• blocks_to_corner_with = []
• enabled_states (string[])
• y_rotation_offset (float)

defaultSnippets.label: Block Placement Direction
defaultSnippets.description: Adds the "minecraft:cardinal_direction", "minecraft:facing_direction" and/or "minecraft:corner_and_cardinal_direction" states and setter function to the block.

minecraft:placement_direction.x-runtime-constraint-description: "y_rotation_offset" can only be used when "minecraft:cardinal_direction" and/or "minecraft:facing_direction" are enabled in "enabled_states". and "blocks_to_corner_with" can only be used when "minecraft:corner_and_cardinal_direction" is enabled in "enabled_states".

minecraft:placement_position.title: Minecraft Placement Position
minecraft:placement_position.description:
Adds the "minecraft:block_face" and/or "minecraft:vertical_half" states and setter function to the block.

Properties:
• enabled_states (string[])

defaultSnippets.label: Block Placement Position
defaultSnippets.description: Adds the "minecraft:block_face" and/or "minecraft:vertical_half" states and setter function to the block.

block_connection.title: Block Connection
block_connection.description: Adds connection states to the block. The values of these states are updated when the block or neighboring blocks change.

enabled_states.title: Enabled States
enabled_states.description: Which connection states to enable. Options: ["minecraft:cardinal_connections"]. Must specify at least one.

block_multi_block.title: Block Multi Block
block_multi_block.description: Adds the "minecraft:multi_block_part" state and multi block functionality to the block.

direction.title: Facing
direction.description: The direction the block parts are placed starting from 'minecraft:multi_block_part' permutation '0' to permutation 'parts'. Default value is 'up'.

enabled_states.title: Enabled States
enabled_states.description: Which state to enable. Must specify at least one. Options: ["minecraft:multi_block_part"].

parts.title: Parts
parts.description: The number of block parts, this sets the value for state 'minecraft:multi_block_part'. Default value is '2'.

block_placement_direction.title: Block Placement Direction
block_placement_direction.description: Adds the "minecraft:cardinal_direction", "minecraft:facing_direction" and/or "minecraft:corner_and_cardinal_direction" states and setter function to the block.

blocks_to_corner_with.description:
A list of block descriptors that define the blocks to connect with the corner shape.

Properties:
• name (string) = 
• states (int) = {}
• tags (string) =

enabled_states.title: Enabled States
enabled_states.description: Which states to enable. Must specify at least one. Options: ["minecraft:cardinal_direction", "minecraft:facing_direction", "minecraft:corner_and_cardinal_direction"].

y_rotation_offset.title: y Rotation Offset
y_rotation_offset.description: The y rotation offset to apply to the block. Must be [0.0, 90.0, 180.0, 270.0, 360.0]. Default is 0, meaning if the player is facing north, the "minecraft:cardinal_direction" and/or "minecraft:facing_direction" state will be north.

block_placement_position.title: Block Placement Position
block_placement_position.description: Adds the "minecraft:block_face" and/or "minecraft:vertical_half" states and setter function to the block.

enabled_states.title: Enabled States
enabled_states.description: Which states to enable. Must specify at least one. Options: ["minecraft:block_face", "minecraft:vertical_half"].
